title: A Birthday Party
text:
My birthday is in May. It is on the fifteenth of May. My friends come to my house for a party. We eat cake and play games.

My sister's birthday is in December. It is on the twenty-fourth of December. It is a cold day in winter. We have dinner at home and open presents.

questions.text: What is the weather like on the sister's birthday?
How does the writer probably feel about the party?
Why does the writer's family probably have dinner at home on the sister's birthday?
options: Because the shops are closed all year
Because they do not like food

vocabulary.definition: the day of the year when a person was born
an event where people meet to have fun and celebrate
the coldest season of the year
the twelfth month of the year

paragraph_translations: Benim doğum günüm Mayıs ayında. Mayıs'ın on beşinde. Arkadaşlarım bir parti için evime gelir. Pasta yeriz ve oyunlar oynarız.
Kız kardeşimin doğum günü Aralık ayında. Aralık'ın yirmi dördünde. Kış mevsiminde soğuk bir gün. Evde akşam yemeği yeriz ve hediyelerimizi açarız.
